item.title: Frogs Croaked: Collins' heroics hop Lady Raiders past TCU
item.description: After a tough loss to Audi Crooks and Iowa State, the No. 21 Lady Raiders welcomed Big 12 leader TCU to United Supermarkets Arena Sunday. The No. 12 Horned Frogs gave Texas Tech all they could handle, but they were able to hold off their rivals for a thrilling 62-60 win.

item.title: Vacant Lubbock apartment building set on fire early Monday morning
item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas -- Lubbock Fire Rescue responded to an abandoned apartment building fire near the 1700 Block of 48th Street. LFR reported around 5:56 a.m. crews were actively trying to locate and extinguish the fire, as the fire has made its way to the attic space and is quickly spreading. No injuries have been reported [...]

item.title: One person seriously injured after a shooting in East Lubbock
item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas -- Lubbock police responded to an overnight shooting in east Lubbock. LPD confirmed one person suffered serious injuries. The shooting happened near East 2nd Street and Beach Avenue after 2 a.m., according to police. This is an ongoing investigation. Check EverythingLubbock.com as more details become available.

item.description: While spring planting may feel far off during the winter months, local experts say now is one of the most important times to prepare your garden for success.

item.title: Teen killed in motorcycle crash on Marsha Sharp Freeway identified by Lubbock PD
item.description: Sean Canales, 19, was pronounced dead after a motorcycle collision on the Marsha Sharp Freeway in Lubbock, Texas on Sunday night, while Maizie Casares, 17, was transported to University Medical Center with serious injuries.

item.title: Texas Tech suffers first home loss to Kansas in stunner
item.description: With no Christian Anderson at their disposal, Texas Tech held strong against Kansas until the very end. However, the Jayhawks were able to come up clutch to steal away a 64-61 win at United Supermarkets Arena.

item.title: Wolfforth housefire raises safety concerns about fire protection outside of the county
item.description: Thursday, January 26, a house in Wolfforth was engulfed in flames leaving nothing behind. As neighbors watched this house burn down, they noticed fire crews arrived on the scene to help contain the fire, but they had no water.
